full_name: Suki Kim | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Journalism & Nonfiction Catherine A. and Mary C. Gellert Fellow Independent Writer
bio: Suki Kim is an investigative journalist, novelist, essayist, and the only writer to have lived undercover in North Korea. She is the author of the New York Times best seller Without You, There Is No Us: Undercover among the Sons of North Korea’s Elite (Crown Publishers, 2014), a documentation of her six months living in Pyongyang during the final year of Kim Jong-il’s reign.
